23.author: ChipIn
23.text: ChipIn plans data generation and training small threshold models after spec stage.

70.author: ChipIn
70.text: ChipIn notes data too easy (validation perfect) and will weaken seizures, strengthen artefacts.

108.author: ChipIn
108.text: ChipIn found scoring flaw—alarm merged as one event; fixing by splitting alarms >300 s.

165.author: ChipIn
165.text: ChipIn will examine feature distributions before further tuning.

174.author: ChipIn
174.text: ChipIn tested lab acceptance of a 3-comparator AND design (band detector).

209.author: ChipIn
209.text: ChipIn separated designs; validation shows band-3cmp 1.0 sensitivity 0 FA/h, band-2cmp 0.8 sensitivity 0 FA/h, linear never fires…

325.author: ChipIn
325.text: ChipIn chose band-2cmp per rule, verification in progress.

351.author: ChipIn
351.text: ChipIn achieved bit-exact on 4800 windows, proved level2, now adding smoothing wrapper.

389.author: ChipIn
389.text: ChipIn passed level3 with 4800 streamed frames, zero mismatches; moving to patient scoring.

458.author: ChipIn
458.text: ChipIn reported band-2cmp chip finished, 86‑124 gates, cost 650 µm², sensitivity 0.4 (target 0.8), false alarms 0/hr.
